relations: Shifting cloud cover alters the gaps, changing the intensity and angle of the visible sunbeams.
Atmospheric haze scatters sunlight, making the crepuscular rays visible against the darker landscape below.
As clouds drift, the pattern of light and shadow moves across the distant terrain.
The sun's position behind the clouds determines the initial direction and spread of the light rays.
